name: TestExplora
intro: TestExplora 是一个评估大型语言模型主动发现潜在软件缺陷能力的仓库级测试生成基准。它包含来自 482 个仓库、1,552 个 PR 的 2,389 个任务，要求模型依据文档和不同可见性上下文生成能在缺陷版本失败、修复版本通过的测试。
build_method: 真实Issue-PR采集, 调用图可达性过滤, 自动环境构建, F2P真值验证, DocAgent文档
metric: HP, F2P, EC, CFG, 生成测试数
build_method_en: Real Issue-PR Collection, Call-Graph Reachability Filtering, Automated Environments, F2P Oracle Validation, DocAgent Documentation
intro_en: TestExplora is a repository-level test-generation benchmark for evaluating proactive discovery of latent software defects. It contains 2,389 tasks from 1,552 PRs across 482 repositories and asks models to generate tests that fail on the buggy version but pass after the fix under different visibility settings.
metric_en: HP, F2P, EC, CFG, Number of Tests

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.10471 and the official Microsoft TestExplora repository. The pipeline crawls 12,227 issue-PR patches from repositories with more than 1,000 stars, separates test and code patches, and retains only cases where tests explicitly reach repaired functions. It removes intent-doctoring changes, TODO annotations, and pass placeholders, then defines directly invoked entry interfaces. GitHub Actions Runner Images, merged requirements, and Poetry/PDM/pip logic create reproducible environments. Gold tests must fail on the buggy base and pass after the code patch; DocAgent supplies missing entry documentation. The release contains 1,552 PRs, 2,389 tasks, and 482 repositories; Lite has 330 PRs and 517 tasks. Documentation is always visible; White Box adds implementation and dependencies, while Black Box hides them and exposes signatures. Head Pass is test-level accuracy on the fixed version; F2P is the PR-level proportion with at least one generated test passing fixed and failing buggy. Entry Coverage, Change-Focused Coverage, and test count provide diagnostics.
